messages:
Carla B (Account Exec): FYI prospect HarborTech requested a short assurance bundle before legal approves the SOW: SOC2 excerpt, ISO cert, pen-test attestation, and confirmation about KMS/key residency if they pick Dedicated. They need an answer today for the exec deck.

Miguel R (Solutions Eng): I can assemble. For clarity I'll include: 
- SOC2 Type II summary (pdf)
- ISO27001 cert (pdf)
- Pen-test attestation template (signed after "TO:" confirmed)
- Short note on Dedicated KMS options (hosted KMS vs customer-managed KMS)
- Sanitized staging network diagram + presigned upload README

Anya K (Security): We have a one-page pen-test attestation template. We need the customer's legal entity for the "TO:" line. Redactions allowed for internal IPs and exact scan logs. We can sign within 48 hours after we have the recipient name. Also: if they require key residency for Dedicated, we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) in the Private offering; Dedicated can use customer KMS via external key wrap but requires additional onboarding.

Maya L (Legal): Legal will sign the attestation as 'Redwood Inference, Inc. Legal Counsel on behalf of Security'. Please confirm the recipient and whether they need the attestation on company letterhead or via signed PDF. Also need written ack from HarborTech that they accept our template.

Sam P (Infra): Quick on Dedicated/KMS: options are 
1) Hosted KMS (Redwood-managed keys): no extra setup, normal provisioning.
2) Customer-managed KMS (via Cloud KMS or HSM): one-time integration ~$5,000 and +$1,200/mo key management fee. Provisioning ETA for Dedicated w/CMK = ~10 business days after PO and KMS creds exchange. If they choose Hosted KMS, onboarding is ~4 business days. Also we prefer a 3-hour external scan window (Wed 10:00-13:00 UTC).

Carla B (Account Exec): Sounds good. Can someone drop the draft bundle into a read-only dataroom and paste the link? I'll send to HarborTech and ask for the TO: line plus whether they want Dedicated with CMK.

VaultBot: Assurance dataroom created: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/HARBOR-5643219999 (view-only). Uploaded: soc2-summary.pdf, iso27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-template.docx (unsigned), kms-options-note.txt, staging-readme.md

Miguel R (Solutions Eng): Uploaded a short README and presigned upload instructions. Added a `dedicated-pricing.txt` with the CMK uplift and ETAs.

Anya K (Security): Once HarborTech provides the "TO:" line, I can coordinate signature. We'll also include a short redaction policy note in the attestation.

Maya L (Legal): I'll prepare and sign within 48 hours after they confirm recipient and accept template.

Sam P (Infra): Confirming numbers: CMK integration one-time $5,000; +$1,200/mo. Dedicated baseline (no-CMK) estimate $9,000/mo + one-time $5,000 setup. Provisioning ETAs: Hosted 4 business days, Dedicated w/o CMK 6 business days, Dedicated w/CMK ~10 business days. Scan window preference Wed 10:00-13:00 UTC.

Carla B (Account Exec): Thanks everyone. I'll message HarborTech now: include dataroom link, note signed pen-test letter after TO: confirmed (48h), and the KMS/Dedicated uplift + ETA. Will post their reply here. :pray:
